subject: Quick fit feedback + one small next step
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@pritech.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Quick fit feedback + one small next step

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap so we’re aligned and to make it easy for you to share feedback with your team: 

- Goal: Reduce search-relevance latency on product pages and cut per-query cost for vector search by ~40% while preserving top-10 accuracy.
- Current infra: In-house inference on mixed GPU fleet; batch sizes fairly small, cache hits ~12%.
- What we showed: at 80 tokens, our Dedicated config hit ~95 ms p99 with batching and prefix cache — roughly 35–45% cost improvement vs your current baseline in our tests.
- Proposed first step: 2-week Pilot (non-prod) to run a slice of traffic behind a feature flag; success metric = p99 latency <120ms and <10% drop in click-through vs baseline.

Ask: two quick things from your side if you think this is worth exploring:
1) Any initial fit feedback (yes/no + one line on risk you care about) — helps prioritize execs internally.
2) Agree to a 15-minute sync next week to map the pilot scope (I included two slots below).

Slots: https://cal.com/soojin/15 (Tue 1/20 10am PT or Wed 1/21 11am PT)

I've attached a one-pager with the discovery notes and the quick pilot plan for your engineering team to skim: redwood-discovery-notes.pdf (attachment).

No pressure — if this is not a fit, a quick "no" is totally fine and I’ll close the loop.

Cheers,
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Senior AE, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

---

Alex —

Just checking in on the note below. Did you have a minute to look at the one-pager with the pilot plan? I realize Q1 planning is busy — if it helps, we can start with a developer-led spike (no infra changes) that runs inference on a 10% sample of historical queries to validate latency and cost assumptions.

If this is not a priority right now, totally understand — would appreciate a quick reply so I can triage on our side.

Thanks,
Soojin

Bumping one last time — do you have 30 seconds to say whether this is something you want us to continue pursuing or not? Two quick options either way:

A) Yes — let’s do a short technical spike (we can spin up the inference pipeline and run on historical traffic) and I’ll lock in an eng kickoff next week.
B) Not now — say so and I’ll archive the notes; we can reconnect next quarter if timing changes.

If helpful, here’s a proposed 15-minute slot to make decisioning easy: https://cal.com/soojin/15 (Tue 2/3 10am PT).

Appreciate the quick signal either way — saves both our teams time.

Best,
Soojin
